questions.q: Why doesn't Milentije want to go to Budapest by car?
o: The car is old and may break down
questions.e: In the video: "Ako crkne, nema ko da ga gura." — if it dies, there's nobody to push it.

questions.q: What does Roza first assume about the tickets her son is looking for?
o: That they are admission tickets to Kalemegdan
questions.e: In the video: "Bože, pa nisam znala da naplaćuju ulaznice na Kalemegdanu." — God, I didn't know they charge admission at Kalemegdan.

questions.q: What do the tickets turn out to be?
questions.e: In the video: "Ali ovo su karte za Budimpeštu." — But these are tickets for Budapest.

questions.q: Why did Milentije lie to Mum and Miša?
o: So that Miša would come to look after Mum and he could get away
So that Mum would see a doctor
questions.e: In the video: "Slagao sam tebe, slagao sam Mišu da bi on došao da te čuva, ali jedino tako ja mogu da odem na par dana." — I lied to you, I lied to Miša so he'd come to look after you, but that's the only way I can get away for a couple of days.

questions.q: What does Roza do when her son demands the tickets?
o: Hands over the tickets at once
questions.e: In the video: "Janoš, izvini, molim te, ovo će sada biti psihoanalitička seansa, a tebe ću posle zvati Frojd." — Janoš, sorry, please, this will now be a psychoanalytic session, and I'll call you Freud afterwards.

questions.q: What does the interviewer write down after «Vrnjačka Banja, Partizanske Vode, Budva»?
questions.e: In the video: "Ako vam je svejedno, zapisaću Azija." — if it's all the same to you, I'll write down Asia.

questions.q: What does Miša offer his brother?
o: To stay with Mum while he himself «steps in» for the girl
questions.e: In the video: "Ti se nađi mami ovde, a devojci ću ja da priskočim." — You take care of Mum here, and I'll step in for the girl.

questions.q: Where, according to Jovanka, is Miša supposed to be?
o: At a conference in Vrnjačka Banja
questions.e: In the video: "Kaže Jovanka da je otputovao na neko savetovanje u Vrnjačku banju." — Jovanka says he went to some conference in Vrnjačka Banja.

questions.q: What does the passenger say about Serbian taxi drivers?
questions.e: In the video: "samo u Srbiji taksisti ne znaju da voze." — only in Serbia taxi drivers can't drive.

questions.q: What puzzles the heroine as she drinks water?
questions.e: In the video: "Nije mi jasno zašto ja pijem ovu vodu, a uopšte nisam žedna." — I don't get why I'm drinking water when I'm not thirsty.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ja bih mogao *udžbenik* da napišem.
questions.e: udžbenik — textbook.

questions.q: Ima Wi-Fi, ima *klimu*, ima televizor, ima WC.
questions.e: klima — air conditioning.

questions.q: Nekako si postao isuviše *posesivan*, znaš.
questions.e: posesivan — possessive.

questions.q: Kaže da su karte u *džepu*.
questions.e: džep — pocket; džepu is the locative.

questions.q: Biću *odsutan* samo tri dana.
questions.e: odsutan — absent.

questions.q: Nemoj, šta će da kaže komšija Mađarević ako mu *ubiješ* mačku.
questions.e: ubiti — to kill; ubiješ is 2nd sg.

questions.q: Ima da te lepo *isečem* na komade i da te prodam kineskom restoranu!
questions.e: iseći — to cut up; isečem is 1st sg.

questions.q: Mnogo je *teško* sa starima.
questions.e: teško — hard, difficult.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Uopšte nisam *žedna*.
questions.e: žedna — thirsty (nisam žedna — I'm not thirsty).

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Samo u Srbiji *taksisti* ne znaju da voze.
questions.e: taksisti — taxi drivers.

questions.q: Šta ćeš ti tri dana na ___?
questions.e: «Na» for a place takes the locative: na Kalemegdanu.

questions.q: Pitaš jednog od njih ___ i eto.
questions.e: After «od» comes the genitive: od njih dvojice.

questions.q: Sa ___, čeka me dole u autu
questions.e: «Sa» takes the instrumental: sa Sekom.

questions.q: Pošto je Azija, zapisaću ___.
questions.e: Means of transport takes the instrumental: avionom.

questions.q: Kojim prevoznim ___ najviše volite da putujete?
questions.e: Kojim ... sredstvom — neuter instrumental.

questions.q: Pa zašto me nisi upoznao sa ___?
questions.e: Upoznati sa + instrumental: sa prijateljicom.

questions.q: Ja sam tu da ti ___.
questions.e: After «da» the present tense, 1st sg.: da ti pomognem.

questions.q: Pa dve ___, tri dana.
questions.e: After «dve» the genitive singular: dve noći.

questions.q: Onaj čovek se krstio i levom i ___ rukom.
questions.e: Hand is instrumental fem.: i levom, i desnom rukom.

questions.q: Pa šta imaš ti mene da ___?
questions.e: After «da» the verb agrees with the subject «ti»: da gledaš.
